marks.gloss_en: למאי הלכתא? לאו להוציאן בדיינין? -- the gifts are din: to extract them by judges?
לא, לחולקן בדיינין -- to divide them by judges; and as R' Yonatan said (130b.5): not to a priest who is an am haaretz
the baraita: 'this shall be the priests' mishpat' teaches that the gifts are din
למאי? אילימא לחולקו בדיינין -- are breast and thigh not divided by judges? אלא לאו להוציאו בדיינין (130b.7)
R' Yehuda ben Beteira: 'mishpat' teaches the gifts are din; might breast and thigh be din too? 'zeh' says no
they came to his hand in their tevel, and this tanna holds unseparated gifts are as separated
here we deal with where they came to his hand in their tevel state

R' Eliezer: when he returns he shall pay. Rav Chisda answered 'piety' (p_chasidut_reisha); Rava: ועוד, מדרבי אליעזר ליקום וליתוב? -- one does not object from R' Eliezer, so the objection is recast from the seifa
R' Eliezer: a householder travelling who needs to take gleanings, forgotten sheaves, pe'a and poor tithe takes them, and when he returns he shall pay
תנא תני ישלם, ואת אמרת מדת חסידות שנו כאן?! -- the tanna says 'he shall pay'
Rav Chisda: [R' Eliezer's 'he shall pay'] teaches a measure of piety
טעמא דעני, הא עשיר משלם -- אמאי? ליהוי כמזיק מתנות כהונה (130b.12)
the Sages: he was a poor man at that time [and does not pay]
מדת חסידות שנו כאן -- a measure of piety
Rav Chisda: [the Sages' implied 'a rich man pays'] teaches a measure of piety
הא משעת הרמה ואילך מיהא משלם, אמאי? ליהוי כמזיק מתנות כהונה (130b.14)
the baraita: a householder who ate his produce as tevel, or a Levite his tithes as tevel, is exempt from payment -- 'which they set apart': you have rights in them only from separation on
Rav Chisda: one who damages the priestly gifts or eats them is exempt from paying
the reason: if you like, because 'zeh' is written

R' Yonatan: one does not give a gift to a priest who is an am haaretz -- 'to give the portion of the priests and Levites, so that they hold fast to the Torah of the Lord': whoever holds fast has a portion
